author: GamingBolt
description:
Grand Theft Auto needs no introduction. With the first entry releasing all the way back in 1997, the series has grown from strength to strength. Each new entry pioneered a new era of video games and its last entry, GTA 5 was a juggernaut. With GTA 6 releasing soon, we have decided to recap the entire story of the series in one single video. 

Note that we will be recapping only the mainline games in the sentries. In the past we have covered: GTA 1, GTA 2, GTA 3, GTA: Vice City, GTA: San Andreas and GTA 4. But this compilation also includes the full story of recap of GTA 5 as well. So, let’s get started.
title: Grand Theft Auto: The Complete Story - The Definitive Recap Before GTA 6

author: GamingBolt
description:
What Rockstar has shown so far suggests that getting away with a crime could be more complicated in GTA 6. In previous games, getting away with theft, illegal activities, the titular GTA, and more violence was a straightforward process. Public disturbance became the norm. 

However, judging by the various official footage and hands on previews and interviews, it seems that won’t be the case so in modern-day Vice City. Beyond a more hostile city – at least one that won't let you walk all over them – the systems seems to have been evolved. Stealing a car looks more involved, and even a simple hold-up could get messy.
So, first, let me get this out of the way first. 

This feature draws on published previews, interviews and official footage to explore how the game’s systems could come together. We’ve also included a few hypothetical scenarios and wishlist ideas, so keep in mind that those are speculation rather than confirmed features.
title: GTA 6 Could Make The Same Crime Feel Completely Different Across Its Map
